/corecraft/castle-crest/crown-court-3.ht.description: Crown Court 3 is the smallest piece in our Castle Crest series, a single castle tower in Knight Blue and Baby Blue with a pointed spire canopy and one straight slide. Seen from above, the play deck is octagonal, so children can step onto it from more than one side. It suits children aged 3 to 9, and play centres on climbing up and sliding down. The listing gives a capacity of 15 children and a product area of 9'2" x 12'5". With a safe play area of 15'2" x 18'5", it fits easily into a society garden or a nursery corner. Crown Court 3 carries a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Share your site photos and we will place it on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/castle-crest/crown-court-3.ht.spec_paragraph: The tower frame is galvanised pipe, and the canopy, slide and panels are roto-moulded, so nothing on the outside depends on paint to stop rust. We install it self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Keep the 15'2" x 18'5" safe zone clear, give extra room at the slide exit, and check the canopy fixings during routine maintenance.
flags: Capacity of 15 is the same for every Castle Crest station, from this small single tower to Royal Rise. Looks like a default value; confirm with FunPlay.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/castle-crest/crown-court-7.ht.description: Crown Court 7 takes the castle theme up a level for older children. Built in Play Orange, it combines a spiral slide, a swing beam and a climbing panel, so a group of children can split between three activities. The key user group is 5 to 12 years, and play covers climbing, sliding and swinging. The product area is 16'6" x 14'9", and the listed safe play area is 20'6" x 20'9", which suits a school ground or a mid-sized society play area. Capacity is listed as 15 children. Like the rest of the Castle Crest series, it has a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Tell us how much open ground you have and we will check whether Crown Court 7 fits with room to spare.
/corecraft/castle-crest/crown-court-7.ht.spec_paragraph: Because this unit has a swing, the area in front of and behind the seats needs to stay completely clear of other equipment and walkways. The frame is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded slide and panels, installed self-standing or by grouting. Lay rubber flooring under the swing and slide exit, and inspect the swing chains on a fixed schedule.
flags: Safe play area adds 4' to the length but 6' to the width (16'6" x 14'9" to 20'6" x 20'9"), unlike most units which add 5' or 6' on both sides. Confirm.
Swinging is listed but the warranty line does not mention the 1-year cover on bearings and spare parts.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/castle-crest/fortress-fun.htm.description: Fortress Fun is a twin-tower castle with a tube slide and a climbing wall. It comes in three colour pairs: Cherry Red and Baby Blue, Mango Yellow and Forest Green, or Baby Blue and Knight Blue. That choice helps if you want the play area to match a building facade or a school's colours. It is built for children aged 3 to 12, so younger and older siblings can use it together, with play focused on climbing and sliding. The footprint is close to square at 25'5" x 25'2", and it needs a safe play area of 30'5" x 30'2". Capacity is listed as 15 children. The galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope on Fortress Fun are covered for 3 years. Ask us for a layout drawing in the colour pair you prefer.
/corecraft/castle-crest/fortress-fun.htm.spec_paragraph: Fortress Fun is a larger structure, so most sites will need it grouted rather than self-standing; we decide this after seeing your ground. The towers are galvanised pipe with roto-moulded slide and wall panels. A square safe zone of about 30' on each side should stay free of trees, benches and drain covers, with an impact-absorbing surface throughout.
flags: Colour names are misspelt in the source: 'Mnago Yellow & Forst Green'. Written here as Mango Yellow and Forest Green.
Both image descriptions are identical; only the red and blue version is described.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/castle-crest/noble-nook.html.description: Noble Nook is a long castle layout with two towers joined by a rope bridge and a set of swings, so children cross from one turret to the other before sliding down. The pictured version is Lavender Dilly with Play Orange, and it is also available in Knight Blue with Sand Beige or Knight Blue with Play Yellow. It suits children aged 3 to 12, and play includes climbing, sliding and swinging. At 40' x 21'1", with a safe play area of 45' x 26'1", it works best along the length of a park or a rectangular school ground. Capacity is listed as 15 children. Our 3-year warranty on Noble Nook covers the galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Send us your plot dimensions and we will show how it sits on your site.
/corecraft/castle-crest/noble-nook.html.spec_paragraph: The rope bridge is the part that needs the most attention over time, so check the rope and its end fixings during each maintenance visit. Towers are galvanised pipe with roto-moulded components, set self-standing or grouted. Keep the full 45' x 26'1" zone clear, and leave a wider gap in the swing area so children walking past are not in the swing path.
flags: Capacity of 15 seems low for a 40' long two-tower unit with swings and is the same as the smallest Castle Crest unit. Confirm.
Both image descriptions are identical.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/castle-crest/royal-rise.html.description: Royal Rise is the largest station in our Castle Crest series. In Crazy Pink and Sky Blue, it has a central tower with three turrets, tube and spiral slides running outward, rope bridges, a climbing net and swings. From above, the slides and bridges radiate from the middle like spokes, so children spread out instead of queuing at one ladder. It is meant for ages 3 to 12, and play covers climbing, sliding, swinging and hanging. The product area is 42'6" x 40'5" and the safe play area is 48'6" x 46'5", so plan for a large park, resort or township play zone. Capacity is listed as 15 children. The 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. We can prepare a layout drawing showing paths and seating around it.
/corecraft/castle-crest/royal-rise.html.spec_paragraph: A structure this size is normally grouted into a prepared base. It combines galvanised pipe towers, roto-moulded slides and panels, composite laminates and play rope nets. Mark the 48'6" x 46'5" safe area on the ground before work starts, lay rubber flooring across it, and plan regular checks of nets, bridges and swing chains.
flags: Capacity of 15 looks far too low for a structure of 42'6" x 40'5" with several slides, bridges and swings. Likely a default value.
Swinging is listed but the warranty line does not mention the 1-year cover on bearings and spare parts.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/clown-capade/Jambore-3.html.description: Jambore 3 is a compact circus play station from our Clown Capade series. A jester-hat canopy in Crazy Pink and Baby Blue sits over a round platform, with a climbing ladder on one side and a slide on the other. The playful canopy makes it easy to spot across a garden, which younger children like. It is designed for ages 3 to 9, and the play is simple: climb up the ladder and slide down. The product area is 9'11" x 13'5" and the safe play area is 15'11" x 19'5", so it suits a pre-school, a small society play corner or a restaurant garden. Capacity is listed as 15 children. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope have a 3-year warranty. Ask us for a quote and a layout drawing.
/corecraft/clown-capade/Jambore-3.html.spec_paragraph: For a pre-school or nursery buyer, Jambore 3 is low and simple to supervise, with one way up and one way down. The frame is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded canopy, platform parts and slide. It can be installed self-standing or grouted. Keep the safe zone of 15'11" x 19'5" soft underfoot and wipe the slide down after the monsoon season.
flags: URL uses a capital J (/Jambore-3.html) while Jambore 5 is lowercase. Check the final URL scheme.
Series name 'Jambore' may be a misspelling of 'Jamboree'. Confirm the intended product name.
Capacity of 15 seems high for a single-slide unit of 9'11" x 13'5". Confirm.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/clown-capade/chuckle-chums.ht.description: Chuckle Chums is a two-tower circus station for children aged 5 to 12, linked by a tube climber and a net bridge, with three slides coming off the towers. The pictured colour is Play Red with Forest Green, and it is also offered in Play Orange with Lavender Dilly, or Crazy Pink with Sand Beige. Children climb through the tunnel, hang from the net bridge and pick one of the slides on the way down, which keeps a large group moving. The product area is 35'5" x 19'3" and the safe play area is 41'5" x 23'3", a long, narrow shape that fits beside a building or along a school boundary. Capacity is listed as 15 children. Chuckle Chums has a 3-year warranty on its galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Share your site plan and we will mark it up.
/corecraft/clown-capade/chuckle-chums.ht.spec_paragraph: The net bridge and tube climber are the working parts children load most, so they are made from play rope and roto-moulded sections over a galvanised pipe frame. Installation is self-standing or grouted. With three slide exits, plan the safe zone so that no slide ends near a path, and keep rubber flooring under every exit.
flags: Colour name misspelt in the source: 'Creazy Pink'. Written here as Crazy Pink.
Safe play area adds 6' to the length but only 4' to the width. Confirm.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/clown-capade/jambore-5.html.description: Jambore 5 is the bigger sibling of Jambore 3, built for children aged 5 to 12 who want more of a challenge. It keeps the Crazy Pink and Baby Blue circus colours but adds a spiral slide, trapeze bars on an arm that reaches out from the tower, and a climbing net. Play moves from climbing the net and ladder to hanging from the trapeze bars, then down the spiral slide. Its product area is 21'10" x 18'7", and it needs a safe play area of 27'10" x 24'6". That size suits a school ground or a society that already has toddler equipment and wants something for older children. Capacity is listed as 15. Jambore 5 is backed by a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us for a layout drawing.
/corecraft/clown-capade/jambore-5.html.spec_paragraph: Trapeze bars mean children will be hanging and dropping, so the surface under the arm matters as much as under the slide. Lay rubber flooring across the full 27'10" x 24'6" zone. The frame is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded slide and panels and a play rope net, installed self-standing or grouted after we see your ground.
flags: Safe play area width 24'6" does not follow the usual rule (product width 18'7" plus 6' would be 24'7"). Possible typo.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/clown-capade/jumbo-jive.html.description: Jumbo Jive is the largest piece in our Clown Capade series. This multi-colour circus playground has several jester-hat towers, tube slides and a yellow slide, along with a climbing wall, rope bridges, a tunnel climber and a swing set. It is built for children aged 3 to 12, so toddlers can stay on the lower parts while older children cross the bridges. Play includes climbing, sliding, hanging and swinging. The product area is 43'11" x 32'4" and the safe play area is 47'11" x 38'4". That puts it in the range of public parks, large townships and resorts. Capacity is listed as 15 children. Every galvanised pipe, roto-moulded part, composite laminate and play rope on Jumbo Jive has a 3-year warranty. We can work out a layout that leaves space for parents' seating around it.
/corecraft/clown-capade/jumbo-jive.html.spec_paragraph: Jumbo Jive is usually grouted, because its towers, bridges and swing frame need a fixed base across a large area. Materials are galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Mark entry points to the play zone away from the swing set, and schedule regular checks of bridges, nets and chains.
flags: Capacity of 15 looks far too low for a 43'11" x 32'4" structure with several towers and a swing set. Likely a default value.
Colour is given only as 'Multi Color'. A colour breakdown would help buyers.
Safe play area adds 4' to the length and 6' to the width. Confirm.
Height is listed as NA.

/corecraft/clown-capade/tumble-twin.html.description: Tumble Twin has two clown towers in Crazy Pink and Banana Yellow, joined by a rope bridge, with slides on each side and a climbing panel to get up. The two-tower plan lets children chase each other from one end to the other, which is why it suits school breaks and busy society evenings. It is meant for children aged 5 to 12, and play covers climbing, sliding and hanging. The product area is 34' x 17'7", with a safe play area of 40' x 22'7". The narrow width makes it a good choice for a side lawn or a strip of open ground between buildings. Capacity is listed as 15 children. For Tumble Twin, the galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope are under a 3-year warranty. Send us your measurements and we will confirm the fit.
/corecraft/clown-capade/tumble-twin.html.spec_paragraph: Each tower stands on galvanised pipe posts, and the bridge uses play rope between them, so the towers must be set level and square to each other. We install self-standing or by grouting. Keep the 40' x 22'7" zone free of hard edges such as kerbs, and check the bridge rope tension during routine maintenance.
flags: Both image descriptions are identical.
Height is listed as NA.
